intermediate.name: San Miguel de Aralar
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (1) San Miguel de Aralar (145.4 km)

story: Seven riders formed the breakaway after an initial group of five was joined by Bruno Armirail and Raul Garcia Pierna. With 26 km remaining, Paul Seixas launched a decisive attack, catching them one by one and finishing nearly 90 seconds ahead of the main favorites’ group.
